name: Hokuto

[spoiler]Hokuto is [url=/c26]Kuranari Takeshi[/url] and [url=/c30]Komachi Tsugumi[/url]'s son from their relationship during the year 2017 LeMU  incident. He is also [url=/c31]Matsunaga Sara[/url]'s twin brother.
